chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

He was asked about a man who joined the Imam in his salat (prayer) after the Imam had preceded him by one rakʿah. Then when the Imam finished, he left with the people, and afterward remembered that one rakʿah had escaped him. He said: He repeats it as one rakʿah.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat (prayer), referring to the congregational prayer being performed
key_terms.فَاتَتْهُ: was missed by him or escaped him
key_terms.يُعِيدُهَا: he repeats or performs it again to make up what was missed

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he joined the Imam late by one rakʿah and forgot to complete it after the congregation ended?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who joined congregational salat (prayer) late by one rakʿah and then departed after the Imam without completing what he had missed. If he later remembers, he completes the missed portion by performing one rakʿah.
